document_title: Direct Testimony of Chelsea Hotaling on behalf of Georgia Interfaith Power & Light and Southface Energy Institute - Public Disclosure version
filer: Georgia Interfaith Power & Light and Southface Energy Institute (filed by Southern Environmental Law Center)
how_obtained: Fetched the GA PSC FACTS document-detail page /search/facts-document/?documentId=222504 to read its download link, then downloaded the ZIP '2025_05_02_56002_56003_gipl-southface_direct_testimony_combined_pd (4).zip' from the public API endpoint https://services.psc.ga.gov/api/v1/External/Public/Get/Document/DownloadFile/222504/103935. Unzipped it and took only 'GIPL Hotaling Tesimony.pdf' (the filer's own misspelling of the filename); the Patel and Sherwood testimony PDFs in the same archive were left alone. This is the public-disclosure version - the trade-secret version named in the cover letter was NOT retrieved. Converted the PDF to text with pdfminer.six extract_text(). Saved exactly as pdfminer emitted it - no reflow, no de-hyphenation, no ligature or soft-hyphen repair; running heads, marginal line-number columns, dot leaders and form feeds all left in place.
